doc: Elyms fashion 1 (alt; futuristic streetwear). Clothes_fashion1_1.png is the dark denim outfit with torn skin cut-outs and silver hardware; Body_fashion1_2.png is a mechanical-accessory sheet whose LightMap is a default grey, so it gets its normal map only. Its face sheet and hair 2 and 3 are its own; EyeLash shares the default face hash (generated with Elyms). Converted on 2026-11-03 from the game's own texture rips (Codex's port, nte15_gmod; zips in ipg\nte_15), without AABB, applied to the four ragdolls in the active session. The game has no roughness or metallic map: its toon shader reads T_*_n (a real normal map, used as the sheet's normal_map), T_*_m (LightMap: R spec intensity, B a flat specular-size class per material) and T_*_id (ramp and matcap selector; red 0 = skin), so scripts/ue_toon_maps.py derives roughness from _m.B and _m.R, skin (ID red 0) at the standard 0.70, and metallic from the strongest spec texels whose paint is bright silver or gold. The convert rules are an interpretation (see that script's header). The PMX names Body_1/Body_2 mean the main outfit sheet here, not skin: pinned to cloth. Face, eyes and hair keep the anime-safe and class values; hair sheets and tiny alpha-blend fur tiles were left out. Shared sheets (face, eyes, Hair_hair_1) are generated by one model only.
